test_title: PYST 54: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A dime a dozen
solution:
The correct answer is '**Something common and not special**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**A dime a dozen**" means something that is very common and not special.
 
• It implies that the item or thing in question is easy to come by and has little value due to its abundance.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Variety of amenities: It does not fit the context of the idiom.
 
• Very wealthy: It does not fit the context of the idiom.
 
• A fair trade: It does not fit the context of the idiom.
